forgiving_reciprocal

<DESCRIPTION>
Defect initially to exploit unconditional cooperation, then cooperate when the opponent has cooperated in either of the two most recent rounds. This restores mutual cooperation quickly after a single retaliatory response while defecting against persistent defectors.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 1 if len(opponent_history) == 0 else (0 if opponent_history[-1] == 0 or (len(opponent_history) > 1 and opponent_history[-2] == 0) else 1)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
```
